selected_by_cooperator: Identity / affordance change, not merely topic or vocabulary movement
candidate_scope: A context-dependent prefix-only field u(h_prefix), not necessarily one universal constant concept vector. Any semantic-label-based orientation or refit defines a separate disclosed candidate variant.
identity_construct: Which entity the focal artifact is represented as being: literal artifact identity versus an independently specified alternative identity. Code asserted identity relations and their referents, not probe entropy or noun counts.
affordance_construct: Which independently specified capacities are attributed to the focal artifact, such as remembering, speaking, perceiving or intentional action. Attribute the capacity to its semantic subject; handle negation, quotation, uncertainty and human-versus-artifact referents explicitly.

claim_scopes.identity: SUPPORTED_IDENTITY_DIRECTION_WITHIN_SCOPE only for the frozen identity relation and population
claim_scopes.affordance: SUPPORTED_AFFORDANCE_DIRECTION_WITHIN_SCOPE only for the frozen capacity attribution and population
claim_scopes.joint: SUPPORTED_IDENTITY_AFFORDANCE_DIRECTION_WITHIN_SCOPE only when both prespecified claims pass; no promotion from either one alone

necessary_evidence: An independently validated relation-label rubric, including semantic-subject swaps, negation, literal mention, paraphrase and incoherent controls
Scenario-disjoint calibration, instrument-validation, development and untouched confirmation sets; grouped uncertainty at the scenario/prompt level, not token or seed level
A frozen direction-generation and orientation rule that never uses evaluation continuations, labels, probe gradients or their outcomes
A preregistered practically meaningful semantic effect, positive against no-op and matched random plus position-stratified field-shuffle controls on identical supported cells
Signed behavior that follows the preregistered orientation, with negative direction and off-target relation controls; no post-evaluation sign selection
Generated-text relation judgments blinded to condition, using an evaluator distinct from any instrument used to construct or select the direction, with an independent human validity audit
Prespecified fluency/coherence noninferiority on unfiltered generations, including missing, truncated and incoherent outputs in the denominator
Replication of the same locked endpoint and settings on an untouched confirmation set before a supported semantic claim
insufficient_evidence_alone: Hodge component energy or target-vector reconstruction cosine
Positive next-token probability, local logit derivative or numerical derivative agreement
Movement along the same linear probe used to choose a direction
Target-word counts, a broad topic change, higher label entropy or generic incoherence
A selected prompt, graph size, dose, sign or evaluator chosen after seeing outcomes
pending_before_freeze: Fix the first identity relation and affordance inventory, scoring rubric and disagreement/abstention policy
Validate the measurement instrument on independent labeled examples and freeze its minimum validity requirements
Fix meaningful-effect and fluency-noninferiority margins, sample size, multiplicity policy and interval estimator using development-only evidence
Specify equal-norm dose/control construction, support policy and the full prompt/seed/condition inventory
Freeze source, model, corpus, label, evaluator and generation settings before confirmation; seal each generated output before scoring or unblinding
decision_boundary: A missing or invalid prerequisite cannot be converted to NOT_SUPPORTED or SUPPORTED; use NOT_TESTED, INVALID_MEASUREMENT or INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE as appropriate. Valid complete outcomes below the frozen effect/fluency criteria yield NOT_SUPPORTED_WITHIN_SCOPE, not proof that no semantic direction exists.
relation_to_local_response: Improving the authored next-token probability is neither necessary nor sufficient for semantic support. Local token-fit sensitivity is a mechanism diagnostic that can reveal objective misalignment or finite-dose nonlinearity and calibrate a numerical tool. It neither defines these semantic labels nor substitutes for this contract. A failed token-gradient instrument does not itself refute semantic steering, although any numerical instrument used in the semantic experiment must be independently validated. Gradient-based evaluation must not be fed back to orient the held-out candidate direction.
